QuestInfo.name: Help a Whale Out
QuestInfo.0: There's a strange whale on the beach. What's the big idea, whale?
QuestInfo.1: The whale claims to be THE Prince of Whales, but he doesn't have enough Mana to change into his true form. #bA bottle of Mana Elixir#k should fix him up. You can get a #bMana Elixir#k from the nearby General Store.
QuestInfo.2: The prince transformed. He wasn't just any other whale, after all.

0.0: Hello... Could you help me, please? I'm running...out of strength.\r\nAh... I've run out of Mana... I feel so weak... Could you please bring me #b1 Mana Elixir#k?\r\n

yes.0: My goodness, that was refreshing! Thank you. I know how I look, but I'm actually #b#p1092003##k, the Prince of Whales. That's whales with an 'h'. Confusing, I know.

no.0: Ah... Please... Mana is my life...

1.0: Ahh...my powers are returning. Thank you so much.

item.0: Please... I need just 1 Mana Elixir. The #bGeneral Store#k has them... But I'm too weak to flop over there...
